## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Validation

List the automated and manual checks run.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated regression coverage where practical.
- [ ] I updated user-facing documentation and the changelog when behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, confidential documents, or unredacted run artifacts.
- [ ] I kept manifest and lockfile changes synchronized.
- [ ] I reviewed privacy, security, accessibility, and cross-platform impact.
